A0208.title: Refund and Dispute Risk-Control Strategy
A0208.description: Collects order, logistics, device, and behavioral characteristics for refunds, chargebacks, after-sales, and claims. Applies behavioral models, evidence chain verification, and rule-based scoring to identify abnormal requests, combined with manual review mechanisms to detect fraudulent refunds.
A0208.definition: Build behavior models, evidence-chain validation, and manual review for refunds, chargebacks, after-sales cases, and claims.
A0208.limitation: Fraud rings can organize crowdsourced real-person orders and fabricate logistics and chat evidence to bypass behavioral models. Normal after-sales surges and insufficient dispute evidence can lead to false positives and incorrect blocks. Cross-border chargeback rules vary significantly; when evidence chains are incomplete, model recall drops and the risk of missed detections increases.
